evidence:
Enumerated every value the 2 render/constraints gate criteria, 38 functional, 6 polish and 3 visual criteria tell the judge to create. Only one fixed literal is named: 'MULTI' in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:101 ('Type the five characters MULTI as normal sequential keys'). A case-sensitive search of the whole frozen task (excluding package-lock.json) finds MULTI only on that line; the built bundle solution/app/public/assets/index.js, public/index.html and both runner.html files contain 0 occurrences (lower-case 'multi-caret' CSS class names at src/custom-editor.js:1191 and src/style.css:19 are not source text and the criterion compares the rendered source). All other probes are judge-chosen ('exact unique title', 'distinctive marker', 'distinctive literal', 'two small integers you choose'), per tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:22 'You may choose the exact fixture text for each criterion. Check that the editor holds it before acting.' The seed holds no records: environment/assets/seed_data.json:2 '"snippets": []'. The reference starts with an empty library: solution/solve.sh:37 removes /app/app.db before copying, and server.js has INSERT INTO snippets only inside the POST handler (server.js:70); server.js:167 is an INSERT OR IGNORE backfill of revisions from existing snippets, not seeding. The only pre-existing content is the default draft at src/app.tsx:93 ('

Hello, Colderwater

' / 'Ready to explore.'), which is not a sum, marker or title any criterion asks for; the render gate says 'Clear the draft' (gates/render/judge.toml:23) and requires a second Run with a changed integer, so the default output cannot satisfy it. Records accumulating across criteria are handled by tests/app_context.md:21 ('Saved records are identified by the server, not by title ... Do not assume an empty library') and criteria that record identity and revision (functional/judge.toml:308). Broken-app attempt: an app that pre-seeds a library row or prints fixed preview text gains nothing, because every persistence criterion requires a judge-chosen unique title/source read back from a second context, and every runtime marker is judge-authored. Conforming-alternative attempt: an app whose New draft starts with a different example or empty (allowed by overview.md:3) is not harmed, since criteria enter their own fixture. No configured judge run exists, so this is a static finding; the row's own check (check-probe-not-in-seed.py) is static and was applied by hand, not run as the private checker.
